title: Scaffold name validation
responsibility: Validates safe project/code/field names and derives valid route, kebab-case and export names.

inputs.name: validateProjectName.name
inputs.description: Project name text passed to the project validator. It is trimmed and must be nonempty, contain no '..', slash, or backslash, and start with a letter or number followed only by letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores.

inputs.name: validateName.name
inputs.description: Candidate name text passed to the shared validator. It is trimmed and must be nonempty, contain no '..', slash, or backslash, and start with a letter or number followed only by letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores.

inputs.name: validateName.label
inputs.description: Human-readable label interpolated into validation failure messages for the candidate name.

inputs.name: validateFieldName.name
inputs.description: Field name text passed to the field validator. It is trimmed and must satisfy the shared nonempty safe-name rules, including the allowed letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores.

inputs.name: validateCodeName.name
inputs.description: Code name text passed to the code-name validator. It is trimmed and must satisfy the shared nonempty safe-name rules, including the allowed letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores.

inputs.name: validateRouteName.name
inputs.description: Candidate code name passed through code-name validation before conversion with toKebabCase. The generated route string must not be empty.

inputs.name: validateExportName.name
inputs.description: Candidate code name passed through code-name validation before conversion with toCamelCase. The converted value must match the TypeScript identifier pattern checked by the implementation.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.name
inputs.description: Name text is trimmed, then must match one or more lowercase letter-or-digit segments separated by single hyphens. Empty text, uppercase letters, spaces inside, underscores, and repeated or leading or trailing hyphens fail.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.label
inputs.description: Human-readable label interpolated into the failure message when the value is not lowercase kebab-case.

outputs.name: validateProjectName
outputs.description: The trimmed project name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

outputs.name: validateCodeName
outputs.description: The trimmed code name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

outputs.name: validateFieldName
outputs.description: The trimmed field name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

outputs.name: validateRouteName
outputs.description: The nonempty string returned by toKebabCase for a code name that passed validation.

outputs.name: validateKebabName
outputs.description: The trimmed value after it matches the lowercase alphanumeric-segments-separated-by-single-hyphens pattern.

outputs.name: validateExportName
outputs.description: The toCamelCase result for a code name that matches the checked TypeScript identifier pattern.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised by fail when a name is empty or unsafe, when route conversion produces an empty string, when an export conversion fails the TypeScript identifier check, or when a value fails the lowercase kebab-case pattern.

inputs.name: validateProjectName.name
inputs.description: Project name text passed to the project validator. It is trimmed and must be nonempty, contain no '..', slash, or backslash, and start with a letter or number followed only by letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores.

outputs.name: validateProjectName
outputs.description: The trimmed project name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the project name is empty after trimming, contains '..', '/' or '\', or fails the shared safe-name pattern.

inputs.name: validateName.name
inputs.description: Candidate name text passed to the shared validator. It is trimmed and must be nonempty, contain no '..', slash, or backslash, and start with a letter or number followed only by letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, or underscores.

inputs.name: validateName.label
inputs.description: Human-readable label interpolated into validation failure messages for the candidate name.

outputs.name: validateName
outputs.description: The trimmed input name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the name is empty after trimming, contains '..', '/' or '\', or fails the shared safe-name pattern.

inputs.name: validateFieldName.name
inputs.description: Field name text passed to the field validator. It is trimmed and must satisfy the shared nonempty safe-name rules, including the allowed letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores.

outputs.name: validateFieldName
outputs.description: The trimmed field name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the field name is empty after trimming, contains '..', '/' or '\', or fails the shared safe-name pattern.

inputs.name: validateCodeName.name
inputs.description: Code name text passed to the code-name validator. It is trimmed and must satisfy the shared nonempty safe-name rules, including the allowed letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, and underscores.

outputs.name: validateCodeName
outputs.description: The trimmed code name after it passes the shared safe-name rules.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the code name is empty after trimming, contains '..', '/' or '\', or fails the shared safe-name pattern.

inputs.name: validateRouteName.name
inputs.description: Candidate code name passed through code-name validation before conversion with toKebabCase. The generated route string must not be empty.

outputs.name: validateRouteName
outputs.description: The nonempty string returned by toKebabCase for a code name that passed validation.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when code-name validation fails or toKebabCase returns an empty string.

inputs.name: validateExportName.name
inputs.description: Candidate code name passed through code-name validation before conversion with toCamelCase. The converted value must match the TypeScript identifier pattern checked by the implementation.

outputs.name: validateExportName
outputs.description: The toCamelCase result for a code name that matches the checked TypeScript identifier pattern.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when code-name validation fails or the toCamelCase result does not match the TypeScript identifier pattern /^[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*$/.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.name
inputs.description: Name text is trimmed, then must match one or more lowercase letter-or-digit segments separated by single hyphens. Empty text, uppercase letters, spaces inside, underscores, and repeated or leading or trailing hyphens fail.

inputs.name: validateKebabName.label
inputs.description: Human-readable label interpolated into the failure message when the value is not lowercase kebab-case.

outputs.name: validateKebabName
outputs.description: The trimmed value after it matches the lowercase alphanumeric-segments-separated-by-single-hyphens pattern.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when the trimmed value does not match the lowercase alphanumeric-segments-separated-by-single-hyphens pattern.
